description: Open Autonomy's world: the platform worker built from this tree, metering against the model gateway (the openai twin playing the gateway's OpenAI wire, scripted by the cookbook's scenario) and the GitHub twin, with the world playing GitHub Actions for it. Cookbooks are the projects under test, run as the template runs them (world/stack.ts); nothing in the world calls a real API. ${TWINS_ROOT}, ${WORLD_DIR}, ${SCENARIO} and ${COOKBOOK} are substituted by world/run.ts into an ignored generated copy.
